description: Observed/expected on test within tiers of predicted risk (lowest 50%, 50-80%, top 20%)
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity; train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: Tiers from the 20 equal-weight reliability groups of each model's test predictions; Weighted (WEIGHT) and unweighted metrics; 95% percentile CIs from 200 Rao-Wu rescaled bootstrap replicates of PSU_VAR within PSUSTRAT (seed config.RANDOM_SEED)
